title: Norwegian-Style Wrap
description: A simple and delicious wrap filled with Norwegian-inspired flavors. This recipe is quick and easy to make.
instructions: Preheat a pan to medium heat.
Cook the salmon fillet for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the salmon rest for 1-2 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Warm the tortilla wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading a layer of rice on the bottom half of the tortilla, followed by a layer of sliced salmon, crumbled feta cheese, and a sprig of fresh dill.
Fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling and serve immediately.
